'''Kuari Souvenirs''' was a shop aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']], located on the [[Bazaar Deck]]. It was run by an old lady named [[Vern]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and amongst its wares were a [[crystal mood-vase]], a pair of mounted [[Bantha/Legends|Bantha]] horns, two [[Anorelgan slip-socker]]s, along with [[holo-chit]]s of the [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] and its ports of call.
